subject: Staged SKU reservation + cloud fallback for Orion Health deal
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@archetech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged SKU reservation + cloud fallback for Orion Health deal

Alex —

Thanks for taking the time on Friday. Orion just moved the signature window up by six weeks and we need a firm plan to lock capacity without overcommitting on units we might not need if their usage ramps slower than expected. High level ask: can ArcheTech set aside a tranche of the A100-64Q SKUs and hold them for Redwood pending a partial deposit (we're proposing 30%)?

Quick constraints from our side:
- Need at least 60 GPUs reserved and staged for Q4 delivery with staged shipping (30/30) possibility.
- We need the option to defer the second tranche up to 90 days with a modest restocking fee, since Orion's traffic curve is still uncertain.
- Documented ETA windows and a short SLA on shipment dates so we can tell the customer an onboarding window.

If we can't get a sufficient hold on OEM inventory, we plan to gate a 6-month cloud reservation with NebulaCloud as a fallback to guarantee capacity while we wait for hardware. Ben and Karthik are on copy to coordinate the procurement/legal side.

Please send a short mutual action plan and a one-page commercial quote (deposit amount, payment milestones, cancellation terms). If you already have an internal SKU hold form, that works — attach it.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0183

Attachment(s): none in this initial mail
From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@archetech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@archetech.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged SKU reservation + cloud fallback for Orion Health deal

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the context and the accelerated window. We can do a staged reservation but need to lock terms quickly to hold the manufacturing slot. High-level response:

- We can earmark 60 A100-64Q SKUs and offer a staged shipping schedule (30 by 2027-11-15, second 30 by 2028-01-10) subject to confirmation of deposit.
- Deposit: 30% of committed hardware line-item (non-refundable against manufacturing costs), balance invoiced at shipment.
- Defer option: second tranche may be deferred up to 90 days at a 5% restocking/holding fee if requested before first-shipment cutover.
- ETA bands: manufacturing Q3–Q4 with port/transport contingency; specific ship weeks will be supplied once purchase order and deposit hit the account.

I attached our formal quote (OEM_quote_Q345.pdf) and a short SKU-hold confirmation template. Two asks on our side: 1) signed PO or LOI that matches the quoted line items, 2) confirmation of whether Redwood will use NebulaCloud as a documented fallback (we need to know if you intend to exercise cloud backfill to reconcile inventory planning).

If those are acceptable, procurement can generate an invoice for the deposit and we'll mark the slots.

Best,

Alex Novak
Strategic Accounts — Hardware Partnerships
ArcheTech Systems

Attachment(s): OEM_quote_Q345.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@archetech.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, procurement@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged SKU reservation + cloud fallback for Orion Health deal

Alex —

Quick internal alignment and asks from procurement/product ops:

1) We will proceed with the 30% deposit to hold the tranche, conditioned on ArcheTech's commitment to the deferred tranche terms (90 days, 5% fee) and weekly ETA cadence once manufacturing begins. Please confirm the exact legal language we should include in the PO to lock the defer option.

2) Neha: can we get the MAP (mutual action plan) in draft form for legal signoff? I attached a working copy (MAP_draft.docx) with proposed gate milestones: PO/deposit, first-shipment acceptance testing, staging pool handoff, and final acceptance.

3) Ben: I've looped NebulaCloud procurement separately — we want a firm 6-month runway for a reserved instance fallback (no spin-up surprises). If Nebula can't commit to fixed unit pricing and guaranteed availability, we need the full 60 units on OEM hold or to negotiate a scaled cap.

4) Pricing reconciliation: we'll include an escrow clause in the PO for the deposit to be applied to the hardware invoice; if the shipment misses the last agreed ship-week by >30 days without reasonable cause, the deposit converts to a credit that can be applied to Nebula backfill.

Action items:
- Alex: send the PO language snippet for defer + hold + fees by tomorrow EOD.
- Lauren: confirm whether Redwood will exercise Nebula backfill as a contractual fallback (yes/no).
- Neha: review MAP draft and push any must-have edits to legal.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): MAP_draft.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Alex Novak <alex.novak@archetech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@orionhealth.com>, capacity@nebula.cloud
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged SKU reservation + cloud fallback for Orion Health deal

All —

Agreement in principle: Redwood will authorize the 30% deposit to ArcheTech and execute the PO language Karthik requests for the defer option. We also want NebulaCloud as the documented fallback for months 1–6 post-contract signature. That gives us commercial cover while the second tranche ships.

I've uploaded a signed PO stub (Signed_PO_RDW_ORION.pdf) to the HubSpot deal and attached here for your records — this is a PO stub that triggers the deposit invoice only. Legal will finalize the rest of the terms next week but will honor the defer/holding language in the stub.

Alex — please confirm you can mark the 60 units and your finance team will issue the deposit invoice to the billing contact on the PO. Once we receive the invoice link, we'll push payment to lock the slots.

Thanks everyone — moving to action.

Cheers,

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Signed_PO_RDW_ORION.pdf
